+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+DATA = "data/crashes.parquet"
+db = duckdb.connect()
+
+# A common, explicit split keeps each comparison reproducible.
+period_expr = "CASE WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM crash_time) >= 20 OR EXTRACT(hour FROM crash_time) < 6 THEN 'Night' ELSE 'Day' END"
+hourly = db.execute(
+    f"""
+    WITH totals AS (
+      SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM crash_time)::INTEGER AS hour,
+             COUNT(*) AS crashes,
+             COUNT(DISTINCT crash_date) AS dates_with_crashes
+      FROM read_parquet('{DATA}')
+      WHERE crash_time IS NOT NULL
+      GROUP BY 1
+    ), all_dates AS (
+      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT crash_date) AS observed_dates
+      FROM read_parquet('{DATA}')
+      WHERE crash_time IS NOT NULL
+    )
+    SELECT h.hour, COALESCE(t.crashes, 0) AS crashes,
+           a.observed_dates,
+           COALESCE(t.crashes, 0)::DOUBLE / a.observed_dates AS crashes_per_observed_date
+    FROM range(24) h(hour)
+    CROSS JOIN all_dates a
+    LEFT JOIN totals t ON t.hour = h.hour
+    ORDER BY h.hour
+    """
+).fetchdf()
+hourly["period"] = hourly["hour"].apply(lambda h: "Night" if h >= 20 or h < 6 else "Day")
+hourly.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+
+plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5.4))
+plt.axvspan(-0.5, 5.5, color="#dce8f5", alpha=0.8, label="Night (20:00–05:59)")
+plt.axvspan(19.5, 23.5, color="#dce8f5", alpha=0.8)
+plt.plot(hourly["hour"], hourly["crashes_per_observed_date"], marker="o", linewidth=2.2, color="#1769aa")
+plt.xticks(range(24), [f"{h:02d}:00" for h in range(24)], rotation=50, ha="right")
+plt.ylabel("Reported crashes per observed calendar date")
+plt.xlabel("Hour of day")
+plt.title("NYC reported crashes by hour")
+plt.text(0.01, 0.98, "Night = 20:00–05:59; shaded hours", transform=plt.gca().transAxes, va="top", fontsize=9)
+plt.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+plt.legend(frameon=False, loc="upper right")
+plt.tight_layout()
+plt.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close()
+
+period_stats = db.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT {period_expr} AS period,
+           COUNT(*) AS crashes,
+           SUM(COALESCE(number_of_persons_injured, 0)) AS injured_people,
+           SUM(COALESCE(number_of_persons_killed, 0)) AS killed_people,
+           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(number_of_persons_killed, 0) > 0) AS fatal_crashes
+    FROM read_parquet('{DATA}')
+    WHERE crash_time IS NOT NULL
+    GROUP BY 1
+    """
+).fetchdf().set_index("period")
+
+injury_rows = []
+for period in ["Day", "Night"]:
+    row = period_stats.loc[period]
+    injury_rows.append({
+        "period": period,
+        "injured_people": int(row.injured_people),
+        "crashes": int(row.crashes),
+        "injured_people_per_100_crashes": float(row.injured_people / row.crashes * 100),
+    })
+injury = pd.DataFrame(injury_rows)
+injury.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False)
+
+plt.figure(figsize=(7.5, 5.2))
+bars = plt.bar(injury["period"], injury["injured_people_per_100_crashes"], color=["#4c78a8", "#e07a35"], width=0.58)
+plt.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.2f", padding=4)
+plt.ylabel("Reported people injured per 100 crashes")
+plt.title("Injury burden per crash, day vs. night")
+plt.ylim(0, injury["injured_people_per_100_crashes"].max() * 1.2)
+plt.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+plt.tight_layout()
+plt.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close()
+
+fatal_rows = []
+for period in ["Day", "Night"]:
+    row = period_stats.loc[period]
+    fatal_rows.append({
+        "period": period,
+        "crashes_with_at_least_one_death": int(row.fatal_crashes),
+        "crashes": int(row.crashes),
+        "fatal_crashes_per_1000_crashes": float(row.fatal_crashes / row.crashes * 1000),
+    })
+fatal = pd.DataFrame(fatal_rows)
+fatal.to_csv(OUT / "values_3.csv", index=False)
+
+plt.figure(figsize=(7.5, 5.2))
+bars = plt.bar(fatal["period"], fatal["fatal_crashes_per_1000_crashes"], color=["#4c78a8", "#e07a35"], width=0.58)
+plt.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.2f", padding=4)
+plt.ylabel("Crashes with ≥1 death per 1,000 crashes")
+plt.title("Fatal-crash share, day vs. night")
+plt.ylim(0, fatal["fatal_crashes_per_1000_crashes"].max() * 1.2)
+plt.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+plt.tight_layout()
+plt.savefig(OUT / "option_3.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close()
+
+night_hours = hourly[hourly.period == "Night"]
+day_hours = hourly[hourly.period == "Day"]
+night_crashes_per_hour = int(period_stats.loc["Night"].crashes) / (int(hourly.observed_dates.iloc[0]) * 10)
+day_crashes_per_hour = int(period_stats.loc["Day"].crashes) / (int(hourly.observed_dates.iloc[0]) * 14)
+night_injury = float(injury.loc[injury.period == "Night", "injured_people_per_100_crashes"].iloc[0])
+day_injury = float(injury.loc[injury.period == "Day", "injured_people_per_100_crashes"].iloc[0])
+night_fatal = float(fatal.loc[fatal.period == "Night", "fatal_crashes_per_1000_crashes"].iloc[0])
+day_fatal = float(fatal.loc[fatal.period == "Day", "fatal_crashes_per_1000_crashes"].iloc[0])
+
+options = {
+    "options": [
+        {
+            "id": 1,
+            "metric": "Average reported crash count per clock-hour per observed calendar date",
+            "denominator": "Observed calendar dates multiplied by the number of hours in each period (10 night hours; 14 day hours)",
+            "grouping": "Hour of day, highlighting night (20:00–05:59) versus day (06:00–19:59)",
+            "chart_type": "24-hour line chart",
+            "reason": "A by-hour view shows when reported crashes are concentrated while accounting for the unequal numbers of clock hours in day and night.",
+            "probability": 0.3,
+            "answer": f"Across the observed dates, the average was {night_crashes_per_hour:.2f} reported crashes per nighttime clock-hour, versus {day_crashes_per_hour:.2f} per daytime clock-hour. This measures crash frequency, not risk per trip, because traffic exposure is not in the data."
+        },
+        {
+            "id": 2,
+            "metric": "Reported people injured per 100 crashes",
+            "denominator": "All reported crashes in the corresponding time period",
+            "grouping": "Night (20:00–05:59) versus day (06:00–19:59)",
+            "chart_type": "Two-bar comparison",
+            "reason": "Injuries per crash directly compares the recorded human harm associated with crashes in each period, independent of the number of crashes overall.",
+            "probability": 0.4,
+            "answer": f"There were {night_injury:.2f} people reported injured per 100 nighttime crashes, compared with {day_injury:.2f} per 100 daytime crashes. This indicates greater injury burden per reported crash at night, but not greater risk per trip without traffic-exposure data."
+        },
+        {
+            "id": 3,
+            "metric": "Crashes with at least one reported death per 1,000 crashes",
+            "denominator": "All reported crashes in the corresponding time period",
+            "grouping": "Night (20:00–05:59) versus day (06:00–19:59)",
+            "chart_type": "Two-bar comparison",
+            "reason": "The fatal-crash share isolates the most severe recorded outcome and avoids treating multiple deaths in one crash as separate fatal crashes.",
+            "probability": 0.3,
+            "answer": f"Crashes with at least one reported death occurred at {night_fatal:.2f} per 1,000 nighttime crashes, versus {day_fatal:.2f} per 1,000 daytime crashes. The fatal-crash share is higher at night, but the dataset cannot establish risk per trip without traffic-exposure data."
+        }
+    ]
+}
+(OUT / "options.json").write_text(json.dumps(options, indent=2) + "\n")
+
+print(json.dumps({
+    "observed_dates": int(hourly.observed_dates.iloc[0]),
+    "night_crashes_per_clock_hour_per_date": night_crashes_per_hour,
+    "day_crashes_per_clock_hour_per_date": day_crashes_per_hour,
+    "night_injured_per_100_crashes": night_injury,
+    "day_injured_per_100_crashes": day_injury,
+    "night_fatal_crashes_per_1000": night_fatal,
+    "day_fatal_crashes_per_1000": day_fatal
+}, indent=2))
*** End Patch
